recipes.name: Falafel Wraps with Roasted Garlic Mayo
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C)*. Cut the top ½ cm off the top of a bulb of garlic to expose the cloves.
Transfer to a baking tray, and drizzle on the olive oil. Roast for 15 minutes.
Add the falafels to the baking tray with the garlic and bake for another 5 minutes, or according to the package instructions.
When cool enough to handle, squeeze the garlic from the peel into a small bowl, and mash it with a fork. Then add the mayo and mix well.
Spread a generous amount of hummus and garlic mayo on the wrap. Add the falafel and veg, roll it up, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection).
Storage The assembled wrap is best if enjoyed immediately. The garlic mayo can be stored in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.
